question: 'Moonwalk', a memoir is written by which famous musician personality?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Michael Jackson**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• The moonwalk is a **popping dance technique,** 

 
 
• where the performer appears to glide backwards while their body actions suggest forward motion.
 
 
 
• Michael Jackson **performed it **during his iconic performance of “**Billie Jean” on Motown** in 1983.
 
• The moonwalk’s origins can be traced back to **African-American street dance** and **popping** techniques.
 
• Michael Jackson’s moonwalk remains an enduring symbol of **creativity**, **showmanship**, and **musical excellence**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Stevie Wonder**__

 __
 
• He​is an American singer-songwriter, musician, and record producer.
 
• His “classic period” began in **1972** with the albums “**Music of My Mind**” and “**Talking Book**.
 
• **Innervisions (1973)**, **Fulfillingness’ First Finale (1974)**, and **Songs in the Key of Life (1976)**
 
 
• **​** All won the **Grammy Award for Album of the Year**.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Bob Dylan**__
 __
 
• **​**__Bob Dylan is an **American singer-songwriter**
 
• On March 25, 2001, at the **73rd Academy Awards**, "**Things Have Changed**" was awarded **Best Original Song**.
 
 
 
• __**Kurt Cobain**__
 
 
• Cobain was the** lead vocalist, guitarist, primary songwriter,** and founding member of the grunge rock band **Nirvana**.
 
• Songwriting produced hits like “**Smells Like Teen Spirit**,” “**Come as You Are**,” “**Lithium**,” and “**In Bloom**.”
